  WHY: Downstream summaries and telemetry get a misleading location signal for cancelled runs, defeating the observability goal of #3753.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:839-858 | severity=high | confidence=5

- scripts/drift_audit.sh:92-101 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `coverage_status` is initialized to `"unknown"` but not updated in all code paths before use.
  WHY: In error paths it can remain `"unknown"` and be displayed incorrectly.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:947-953 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The arithmetic guard on `da_logs_missing` silently swallows non-integer values, so partial-coverage messaging can omit the run-id prefix when parsing fails.
  WHY: Operators see "(partial coverage)" without the missing-run context.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:lines 885-908 (_cached_row_needs_cancelled_failure_point_backfill) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new `cancelled_jobs_seen_set` field is written into `repo_cache_updated` at line ~1617 and persisted via `_cache_write_context`, but `ai-memory/schemas/workflow_log_analysis_cache.v1.json` declares `additionalProperties: false` for each repo object and does not list `cancelled_jobs_seen_set`.
  WHY: With AI memory enabled, every collector run fails to persist the workflow log analysis cache; `cancelled_jobs_seen_set` never survives, so the intended one-time cancelled-run backfill repeats on every execution.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:lines 858-908 (extract_failure_point) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `extract_failure_point` now receives `run_conclusion` but still iterates all jobs/steps looking for `conclusion == "failure"` before it checks the cancelled-run guard.
  WHY: A run whose conclusion is `cancelled` but whose job data contains a failure step can return a failure point instead of the cancellation point.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:lines 947-953 (da_partial_coverage_prefix construction) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The arithmetic test `[ "${da_logs_missing}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null` silently swallows non-integer values in `da_logs_missing`, so the partial-coverage prefix is skipped when parsing fails.
  WHY: Operators see a partial-coverage label without the missing-run context.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:line 839 (extract_failure_point signature) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `extract_failure_point` signature changed from `extract_failure_point(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]])` to `extract_failure_point(jobs: list[dict[str, Any]], *, run_conclusion: str | None = None)`.
  WHY: The keyword-only parameter is backward-compatible for current call sites, but it changes the documented/public contract.
